title: goniopteris cordata
intro: Goniopteris cordata, commonly known as the cord fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The cord fern contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Goniopteris cordata include wound healing, anti-cancer properties, and the ability to modulate the immune system.
